output.english: This is a SIMULATED flood exercise for Richmond, VA. There is flooding with fires and downed power lines near Downtown Junction, East Junction, Broad & 3rd, Shockoe Bottom, and Riverside Apartments, and Lee Bridge is closed. Stay away from these areas and flooded roads, and call for help if you are not safe.
output.spanish: Este es un ejercicio SIMULADO de inundación para Richmond, VA. Hay inundaciones con incendios y cables caídos cerca de Downtown Junction, East Junction, Broad & 3rd, Shockoe Bottom y Riverside Apartments, y Lee Bridge está cerrado. Manténgase lejos de estas zonas y de las calles inundadas, y pida ayuda si no está a salvo.
